title: num2cell
summary: Convert an array into a cell array, optionally preserving dimensions inside each cell.

gpu_support.notes: gpuArray inputs are gathered before host cell construction.

description: `num2cell(A)` creates one cell per element of `A`. `num2cell(A, dims)` keeps the listed dimensions inside each cell and creates cells over the remaining dimensions.
behaviors: Numeric, complex, logical, string, and character arrays are supported.
Without `dims`, every cell contains a scalar value from the input.
With `dims`, each cell contains a slice whose shape is the selected dimensions.
Dimension selectors are one-based positive integers supplied as a scalar or numeric vector.

examples.description: Converting each matrix element to a cell

faqs.question: Does `num2cell` preserve grouped array orientation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Slices use the grouped dimension order and preserve the underlying column-major array data.

gpu_residency: The result is a host cell array.
gpu_behavior: GPU inputs are gathered; no GPU kernels are launched.
